---
title: "All activities"
---

<!-- This page carries no data and is never re-rendered when activities change:
     everything comes from data/activities.js, written by qwrite_data(). The
     scripts are classic (non-module) so the page works from a file:// URL. -->

<script src="lib/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="lib/plot.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="lib/starch-dash.js"></script>
<script src="data/activities.js"></script>

## Trends

::: {.starch-inputs}
<div>
<label for="bucket">Period</label>
<select id="bucket">
  <option value="week">Week</option>
  <option value="month" selected>Month</option>
  <option value="year">Year</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label for="metric">Metric</label>
<select id="metric">
  <option value="distance" selected>Distance (km)</option>
  <option value="time">Moving time (h)</option>
  <option value="elevation">Elevation gain (m)</option>
  <option value="count">Activities</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label>Sports</label>
<div class="starch-sports" id="sports"></div>
</div>
:::

::: {#trends-chart}
:::

## Activities

::: {#activities-table}
:::

<script>
(function () {
  var S = window.STARCH;
  // Not "trends": the "## Trends" heading already claims that id for its
  // <section>, and getElementById would return the section, so drawing the
  // chart would wipe the heading and the controls with it.
  var trendsEl = document.getElementById("trends-chart");
  var sportsEl = document.getElementById("sports");
  var sports = S.sports();

  sportsEl.innerHTML = sports.map(function (s, i) {
    return '<label><input type="checkbox" value="' + s + '" checked> ' + s + "</label>";
  }).join("");

  function chosenSports() {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(sportsEl.querySelectorAll("input:checked"))
      .map(function (i) { return i.value; });
  }

  var table = null;

  function redraw() {
    S.drawTrends(trendsEl, {
      bucket: document.getElementById("bucket").value,
      metric: document.getElementById("metric").value,
      sports: chosenSports()
    });
    if (table) table.setSports(chosenSports());
  }

  document.getElementById("bucket").addEventListener("change", redraw);
  document.getElementById("metric").addEventListener("change", redraw);
  sportsEl.addEventListener("change", redraw);
  // Plot builds a fresh figure on every draw, so resize is debounced
  // rather than run on each event.
  var rt = null;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    clearTimeout(rt);
    rt = setTimeout(redraw, 200);
  });

  var num = function (d) {
    return function (v) {
      return '<span class="num">' + S.fmtNum(v, d) + "</span>";
    };
  };
  var int = function (v) { return '<span class="num">' + S.fmtInt(v) + "</span>"; };
  var dur = function (v) { return '<span class="num">' + S.fmtDuration(v) + "</span>"; };

  var columns = [
    { key: "activity_date", label: "Date", cell: function (v) { return S.fmtDate(v); } },
    // target="_top" so the link is a navigation of the whole frameset when this
    // page is shown inside the index's iframe, not of the iframe itself.
    { key: "activity_name", label: "Name", cell: function (v, r) {
        var label = v || "(unnamed)";
        return r.has_stream
          ? '<a href="dash_index.html#' + r.activity_id + '" target="_top">' + label + "</a>"
          : label;
      } },
    { key: "activity_type", label: "Type" },
    // Strava sets X-Frame-Options, so this one must open in a new tab.
    { key: "activity_id", label: "Strava", cell: function (v) {
        return v ? '<a href="https://www.strava.com/activities/' + v +
          '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + v + "</a>" : "\u2014";
      } },
    { key: "distance_km", label: "Dist (km)", cell: num(2) },
    { key: "elapsed_time_s", label: "Elapsed", cell: dur },
    { key: "moving_time_s", label: "Moving", cell: dur },
    { key: "elevation_gain_m", label: "Elev +", cell: int },
    { key: "average_speed_ms", label: "Avg m/s", cell: num(2) },
    { key: "max_speed_ms", label: "Max m/s", cell: num(2) },
    { key: "average_heart_rate", label: "Avg HR", cell: int },
    { key: "max_heart_rate", label: "Max HR", cell: int },
    { key: "average_cadence", label: "Cadence", cell: int },
    { key: "average_watts", label: "Avg W", cell: int },
    { key: "max_watts", label: "Max W", cell: int },
    { key: "calories", label: "kcal", cell: int },
    { key: "relative_effort", label: "Effort", cell: int },
    { key: "perceived_exertion", label: "RPE", cell: int },
    { key: "activity_gear", label: "Gear" },
    { key: "commute", label: "Commute" },
    { key: "n_rows", label: "Points", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_gps", label: "GPS", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_dist", label: "Dist pts", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_speed", label: "Speed pts", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_hr", label: "HR pts", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_alt", label: "Alt pts", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_cad", label: "Cad pts", cell: int },
    { key: "n_rows_watts", label: "Watt pts", cell: int },
    { key: "stream_columns", label: "Stream columns" }
  ];

  table = S.renderTable(
    document.getElementById("activities-table"), S.activities(), columns,
    { pageSize: 25, sort: "activity_date" }
  );

  redraw();
})();
</script>
